summary: Busy Taringa Parade kerb with a marked lane and no parked cars.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked on this side
Dashed marked lane against the kerb
Bush behind footpath, but no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a footpath on the west side; homes 17 m and 25 m away across the road to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a marked lane with a footpath behind it; no bay, verge or pull-off to get clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way road near a bus stop and school drop-off area.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the west kerb; the markings suggest a bus or cycle lane.

flags: Signs mention bus zone and passenger loading zones
sun_shade: Bush shades the kerb from the west in the afternoon; open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Exact meaning of the dashed lane markings
